title: Measurement of CH<SUB>3</SUB>D on Titan at Submillimeter Wavelengths
question: Can CH3D be detected in Titan's atmosphere at submillimeter wavelengths with ALMA, and what disk-averaged CH3D abundance and D/H in CH4 does it imply?

what.value: CH4 and N2 vertical abundance profiles

evidence.quote: We thus include N$_2$ and CH$_4$ vertical abundance profiles from (cite: niemann_10) and (cite: teanby_13)

what.value: CH3D line and partition function parameters from CDMS

evidence.quote: CH$_3$D spectral line and partition function parameters were obtained from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy
Line broadening and temperature dependence coefficients were obtained from the HITRAN 2012 database
HC$_3$N, using the 2015 disk-averaged abundance profile found in (cite: thelen_19)

what.value: Stratospheric temperature profile from contemporaneous ALMA measurements

evidence.quote: using contemporaneous ALMA measurements from (cite: thelen_18) in the stratosphere and above

recipe.method: Re-ran archive calibration scripts in CASA with updated Titan flux model; Högbom clean imaging

recipe.goal: Extract disk-averaged spectrum and convert to radiance
recipe.method: Mask of pixels with >=90% of continuum flux; convert flux density to radiance using 24 line-of-sight emission angles up to 1200 km
key_parameters: distance 9.038 AU; sub-observer latitude 24.55 deg; Doppler shift -7.5 km/s

recipe.method: CIA continuum from CH4, H2, N2; temperature profile from ALMA stratosphere plus HASI/radio occultation troposphere; data scaled by 1.047
Line-by-line NEMESIS with a constant multiplicative scaling of a priori CH3D profiles (CH4 times D/H from 1.13-1.59e-4); profile shape fixed, other parameters held constant
assumptions: CH3D profile follows CH4 Huygens GCMS profile shape

recipe.method: Compare CH3D abundance with GCMS CH4 profile

answer_key.quantity: CH3D detection significance, J=2-1 line at 465.235 GHz

evidence.quote: measured at significance levels of $4.6\sigma$ and $5.7\sigma$, respectively

answer_key.quantity: CH3D detection significance, line at 465.250 GHz

evidence.quote: measured at significance levels of $4.6\sigma$ and $5.7\sigma$, respectively
disk-averaged CH$_3$D volume mixing ratio = $6.157\times10^{-6}$ in Titan’s stratosphere
the resulting value for D/H in CH$_4$ is $(1.033\pm0.081)\times10^{-4}$
rectified by multiplying the data by a factor of 1.047

not_stated_but_needed: Which ALMA execution block/MS and which calibrator/scripts exactly
Clean mask and number of iterations; weighting scheme
Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method
Pixel mask definition details and how noise/significance was computed
How the 1.047 scale factor was derived exactly
missing_for_reproduction: Fitted temperature and abundance profile tables
score_reason: Public data and software are named, but several imaging and modeling details are missing or deferred to earlier papers.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is mostly described, and the results are numeric, though some details are missing.
